# Log

Structured logging: levels, typed fields, text and JSON-lines records, a process-wide log for every thread, and log files that rotate by size.

## Installation

Add `Log` to the `[Dependencies]` table of your package's `Rux.toml`:

```toml
[Dependencies]
Log = { Namespace = "Rux", Version = "0.1.0" }
```

Standard packages are declared by hand: the registry does not serve them, so `rux add Rux/Log` cannot add them.

## Dependencies

- [`Allocator`](/docs/api/allocator) 0.1.0
- [`Core`](/docs/api/core) 0.1.0
- [`FileSystem`](/docs/api/filesystem) 0.1.0
- [`Format`](/docs/api/format) 0.1.0
- [`Io`](/docs/api/io) 0.1.0
- [`Path`](/docs/api/path) 0.1.0
- [`Sync`](/docs/api/sync) 0.1.0
- [`Text`](/docs/api/text) 0.1.0
- [`Time`](/docs/api/time) 0.1.0

## Guide

Structured logging: levels, typed fields, one line of text or JSON per record, a process-wide log that every thread can write to, and log files that rotate by size.

### What it provides

| Module                                  | Covers                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`Level`](/docs/api/log/level#level)    | [`Level`](/docs/api/log/level#level) from `Trace` to `Error` with [`Name`](/docs/api/log/level#name), [`Label`](/docs/api/log/level#label) and [`Parse`](/docs/api/log/level#parse), and [`CompiledLevel`](/docs/api/log/level#compiled-level) from the `LogLevel` define                           |
| [`Field`](/docs/api/log/field#field)    | [`Field`](/docs/api/log/field#field) with [`Text`](/docs/api/log/field#text), [`Integer`](/docs/api/log/field#integer), [`Unsigned`](/docs/api/log/field#unsigned), [`Float`](/docs/api/log/field#float) and [`Boolean`](/docs/api/log/field#boolean), and its [`Value`](/docs/api/log/field#value) |
| `Record`                                | [`LogFormat`](/docs/api/log/record#log-format): [`Text`](/docs/api/log/field#text) or `JsonLines`                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) | [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) over any `Io::Writer`, with a level, context fields, optional times, and `Trace` to `Error`                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `Global`                                | the process-wide log on standard error: `Trace` to `Error`, `Log`, `SetLevel`, [`SetFormat`](/docs/api/log/global#set-format), `SetTimestamps`, `Enabled`                                                                                                                                           |
| `Rotation`                              | [`RotatingFile`](/docs/api/log/rotating-file), a log file moved aside for a fresh one before a write would take it past a size, and its [`RotatingStream`](/docs/api/log/rotating-stream)                                                                                                           |

The module names describe where each declaration comes from; they are not part of an import path.

### Example

```rux
import Log::{ Field, Info, LogFormat, SetFormat, Warn };

func Serve(port: uint64) {
    SetFormat(LogFormat::JsonLines);
    Info("listening", [Field::Unsigned("port", port)]);
    Warn("no certificate configured");
}
```

### Design

A record has a level, a message, and fields whose values keep their types. As text it is one line: the time, the level, the message, then `key=value` for each field, with a value that holds spaces, quotes or `=` in quotes. As JSON lines it is one object per line, with `time`, `level` and `message` members followed by the fields, and a number that is not finite written as `null`. Line breaks and other control characters are escaped in both formats, so a record never spans lines. Times are RFC 3339 in UTC to the millisecond. They can be turned off for a destination that adds its own, such as a service manager's journal.

Each record is built whole and handed to its destination in a single write. The process-wide functions write to standard error. Their level, format and time settings are read and written atomically, and a lock is held only for the write of a finished record, so threads build records at the same time and their lines never interleave. A [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) writes to any `Io::Writer`, such as a file or a socket, and is used by one thread at a time. Logging never fails: a [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) keeps the first failure to write for [`Failure`](/docs/api/log/logger#failure) to report, and the process-wide log drops a record it cannot write.

A [`RotatingFile`](/docs/api/log/rotating-file) is a `Writer` over a path that keeps a log from growing without end. Before a write would take the current file past its limit, the file is renamed to `path.1`, after an older `path.1` becomes `path.2` and so on up to the number of older files kept, and an empty file takes its place. Rotation happens only between writes, and a [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) writes each record in one call, so no record is ever split across two files; a record larger than the limit gets a file of its own. Hand one to a [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) with `(@file).Stream()`, keeping the file in place while the logger uses it.

The `LogLevel` build define sets the least severe level a build keeps: `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`. A record below it is dropped before any of it is built, whatever level a logger is set to. So a release build defined with `LogLevel = "info"` does no tracing work, while the process-wide level, which starts at `Info`, and each logger's own level are changed at run time.

## Index

### Types

| Name                                              | Summary                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`Value`](/docs/api/log/field#value)              | The value of a field.                                                                                                                           |
| [`Field`](/docs/api/log/field#field)              | A named value of a record.                                                                                                                      |
| [`Level`](/docs/api/log/level#level)              | How severe a record is, from the most detailed to the most serious.                                                                             |
| [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger)           | Writes records at or above a level to a stream, each as one write.                                                                              |
| [`LogFormat`](/docs/api/log/record#log-format)    | How records are written.                                                                                                                        |
| [`RotatingFile`](/docs/api/log/rotating-file)     | A log file that starts afresh before a write would take it past a size.                                                                         |
| [`RotatingStream`](/docs/api/log/rotating-stream) | A stored borrow of a [`RotatingFile`](/docs/api/log/rotating-file) that speaks `Writer`, for a [`Logger`](/docs/api/log/logger#logger) to keep. |

### Functions

| Name                                                   | Summary                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`SetLevel`](/docs/api/log/global#set-level)           | Writes process-wide records at `level` and above from now on.                                                                                               |
| [`SetFormat`](/docs/api/log/global#set-format)         | Writes process-wide records in `format` from now on.                                                                                                        |
| [`SetTimestamps`](/docs/api/log/global#set-timestamps) | Whether process-wide records start with the time.                                                                                                           |
| [`Enabled`](/docs/api/log/global#enabled)              | Whether a process-wide record at `level` would be written.                                                                                                  |
| [`Log`](/docs/api/log/global#log)                      | Writes a process-wide record at `level` with `message` and `fields` to standard error, if the level is enabled.                                             |
| [`Trace`](/docs/api/log/global#trace)                  | Writes a process-wide `Trace` record with no fields.                                                                                                        |
| [`Debug`](/docs/api/log/global#debug)                  | Writes a process-wide `Debug` record with no fields.                                                                                                        |
| [`Info`](/docs/api/log/global#info)                    | Writes a process-wide `Info` record with no fields.                                                                                                         |
| [`Warn`](/docs/api/log/global#warn)                    | Writes a process-wide `Warn` record with no fields.                                                                                                         |
| [`Error`](/docs/api/log/global#error)                  | Writes a process-wide `Error` record with no fields.                                                                                                        |
| [`CompiledLevel`](/docs/api/log/level#compiled-level)  | The least severe level this build keeps, from the `LogLevel` build define: `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`, and `trace` when it is not defined. |
